newsitem.title: USA: Thomson to sell five newspapers.
newsitem.headline: Thomson to sell five newspapers.

text.p: Thomson Corp's Thomson Newspapers and Ogden Newspapers Inc said on Friday they had reached agreement for Odgen to buy five Thomson newspapers in Michigan and Ohio.
As part of the deal, Ogden will transfer ownership of the Marshfield News-Herald in Wisconsin to Thomson.

Thomson is selling four newspapers in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan -- the Daily Press in Escanaba, the Daily News in Iron Mountain, the Daily Mining Gazette in Houghton, and the Mining Journal in Marquette.
It also is selling the Herald-Star in Steubenville, Ohio.
The newspapers affected by the deal have a combined circulation of 92,200.
